1002:
בִּירָה _n.f_. **castle**, **palace**
**1.** of **temple** at Jerusalem
**2.** in these passages appar. means a fortress in the city bearing the same name
1004:
בַּ֫יִת 2034 _n.m_. **house**
**1.** **house**
**2.** **place**
**3.** **receptacle**
**4.** of house as containing a family
**5.** **household**, **family** (592 t.)
**6.** house, including **household affairs**
**7.** lit. **housewards**, hence metaph. **inwards**
**8.** מִבַּיִת
**a.** _adv_. **on the inside**
**b.** _prep_. **within**
1007: בֵּית אָ֫וֶן _n.pr.loc_. (**house of iniquity** or **idolatry** ? hardly likely unless as alteration of orig. בֵּית אוֹן, **house of wealth** or **strength**) eastward from Bethel
1008:
בֵּֽיתְאֵל 71 _n.pr.loc_. **Bethel**
**1.** ancient place and seat of worship in Ephraim on border of Benjamin, identif. with _Luz_ (former name)
**2.** place in south country of Judah, not far from Beersheba & Ziklag
1009: בֵּית אַֽרְבֵֿאל _n.pr.loc_. [[28-hosea.10.14|Ho 10:14]], perh. **Arbel** near Pella (E. of Jordan)
1010: בֵּית בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן _n.pr.loc_. = בְּעֹן [[04-numbers.32.3|Nu 32:3]]; city assigned to Reuben; possessed by Moab
1011: בֵּית לְבָאוֹת _n.pr.loc_. in Simeon (**place of lioness** ?) [[06-joshua.19.6|Jos 19:6]] = ב׳ בִּרְאִי (perh. text. err.) [[13-1-chronicles.4.31|1 Ch 4:31]]; = לְבָאוֹת (in Judah) [[06-joshua.15.32|Jos 15:32]].
1012: בֵּית בָּרָה _n.pr.loc_. in combin. (**place of ford**).
1013: בֵּית גָּדֵר _n.pr.loc_. in Judah (**place of a wall**) [[13-1-chronicles.2.51|1 Ch 2:51]]
1014: בֵּית גָּמוּל _n.pr.loc_. in Moab [[24-jeremiah.48.23|Je 48:23]] (**place of recompense**)
1016:
בֵּית־דָּגוֹן, בֵּית דָּגֹן _n.pr.loc_.
**1.** in Judah (**house**, i.e. **temple of Dagon**)
**2.** in Asher
1017: בֵּית הָאֱלִי _adj.gent_. c. art. **the Bethelite** [[11-1-kings.16.34|1 K 16:34]].
1019:
גִּלְגָּל _n.pr.loc_. (= (sacred) **circle** of stones)
**1.** place E. of Jericho, where Isr. lay encamped
**2.** place on border between Judah & Benjamin
**3.** place in N. Isr., dwelling of prophets
**4.** place in N. Isr. near Mt. Gerizim and Mt. Ebal
**5.** in phr.
1020: בֵּית הַיְשִׁימוֹת _n.pr.loc_. E. of Jordan (**place of the desert**) in Moab; given to Reuben
1023: בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק possibly _n.pr.loc_. house or settlement on bank of Kidron [[10-2-samuel.15.17|2 S 15:17]]
1024: בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת _n.pr.loc_. in Simeon (**place of chariots**)
1025: בֵּית הָעֵ֫מֶק _n.pr.loc_. on border of Asher (**valley-house**) [[06-joshua.19.27|Jos 19:27]]
1026: בֵּית הָֽעֲרָבָה _n.pr.loc_. (**place of the depression**) reckoned to Judah, to Benjamin
1027: בֵּית הָרָם _n.pr.loc_. in Gad [[06-joshua.13.27|Jos 13:27]] = בֵּית הָרָן [[04-numbers.32.36|Nu 32:36]]
1028: בֵּית הָרָם _n.pr.loc_. in Gad [[06-joshua.13.27|Jos 13:27]] = בֵּית הָרָן [[04-numbers.32.36|Nu 32:36]]
1031: בֵּית חָגְלָה _n.pr.loc_. (**place of partridge**) in Benjamin, on border of Judah
1032: בֵּית חוֹרֹן _n.pr.loc_. two cities in Ephraim, lower & upper B.H. (**place of a hole** or **hollow** (?), perh. fr. a wady betw. the two, or near by);—cf. הַחֹרֹנִי _adj.gent_. only of Sanballat
1033: בֵּית כָּ֑ר _n.pr.loc_. (**place of lamb**) appar. belonging to Philistines [[09-1-samuel.7.11|1 S 7:11]].
1034: בֵּית לְבָאוֹת _n.pr.loc_. in Simeon (**place of lioness** ?) [[06-joshua.19.6|Jos 19:6]] = ב׳ בִּרְאִי (perh. text. err.) [[13-1-chronicles.4.31|1 Ch 4:31]]; = לְבָאוֹת (in Judah) [[06-joshua.15.32|Jos 15:32]].
1035:
בֵּית לֶ֫חֶם 41 _n.pr.loc_.
**1.** in Judah, 2 hours south of Jerusalem; birth-place of David
**2.** in Zeb., 7 m. NW. of Nazareth
1036: בֵּית לְעַפְרָה _n.pr.loc_. appar. in Philistine territory [[33-micah.1.10|Mi 1:10]]; site unknown, & txt. dub.
1037:
מִלּוֹא _n.pr.loc_. (Thes ‘**fill**’ of earth, earthwork, but v. GFM [[07-judges.9.6|Ju 9:6]]);—
**1.** near Shechem, site unknown
**2.** citadel in Jerus.
**3.** dub.; = 2?
1039: בֵּית נִמְרָה _n.pr.loc_. E. of Jordan, in Gad (**place of leopard**)
1040: בֵּית עֶ֑דֶן _n.pr.loc_. [[30-amos.1.5|Am 1:5]] Aramaean city, or land
1044: בֵּית־עֵ֫קֶד הָרֹעִים perh. _n.pr.loc_. (**binding-house of the shepherds**) [[12-2-kings.10.12|2 K 10:12]]
1046: בֵּית פָּ֑לֶט _n.pr.loc_. (**place of escape**) in south of Judah; cf. _adj.gent_. הַפַּלְטִי
1047: בֵּית פְּעוֹר _n.pr.loc_. E. of Jordan, in land of Amorites (where assigned to Reuben); in land of Moab
1048: בֵּית פַּצֵּץ _n.pr.loc_. in Issachar (**place of dispersion**) [[06-joshua.19.21|Jos 19:21]]; site unknown.
1050: בֵּית־רְחוֹב _n.pr.loc_. (**place of street**, or **market**?) near Dan on road to Hamath
1051: בֵּית רָפָא _n.pr.loc_.? in Judah; as _n.pr.m_. [[13-1-chronicles.4.12|1 Ch 4:12]].
1052: בֵּית שְׁאָן _n.pr.loc_. in Manasseh, W. of Jordan (**place of quiet**)
1053:
בֵּית שֶׁ֫מֶשׁ _n.pr.loc_. (**sun-temple**)
**1.** city in SW. Judah
**2.** city in Naphtali
**3.** city in Issachar
**4.** = On-Heliopolis, in Egypt

**Qal**
**1.** **weep**
**2.** **weep bitterly**
**3.** **weep upon**
**4.** **bewail**
**5.** in sense of burden, annoy with weeping

**Pi**. **lament**; **bewail**

1068: [בְּכִית] _n.f_. **weeping** [[01-genesis.50.4|Gn 50:4]], i.e. the appointed time of mourning for him.
1069:
[בָּכַר]
_vb_.**Pi**.
**1.** **bear early**, **new fruit**
**2.** **make** or **constitute as first-born**
**Pu**. **born** or **made a firstling**.
**Hiph**. **one bearing her first child**
1071:
בֶּ֫כֶר _n.pr.m_. (**young camel**)
**1.** son of Ephraim
**2.** son of Benjamin
1073: בִּכּוּרָה _n.f_. **first ripe fig**, **early fig** (regarded as delicacy); pl. בַּכֻּרוֹת [[24-jeremiah.24.2|Je 24:2]].
1078: בֵּל _n.pr.m_. a chief Babylonian diety = **Merodach**, tutelary god of Babylon
1081: בַּלְאֲדָן _n.pr.m_. (= Bab. **abal-idinna**, **he has given a son**)

[בָּלַג] _vb_. **gleam**, **smile**—only **Hiph**.
**1.** **shew a smile**, **look cheerful**
**2.** **cause to burst** or **flash**
1083:
בִּלְגָּה _n.pr.m_. (**cheerfulness**)—
**1.** priest of 15th course (David’s time)
**2.** priest that went up with Zerubbabel
1086:
[בָּלָה] _vb_. **become old and worn out**
**Qal** **wear out**
**Pi**. caus. of Qal.
**a.** **wear out** (trans.)
**b.** **wear out by use**, **use to the full**, **enjoy**

בִּלְהָה _n.pr.f_. (etym. dub.) handmaid of Rachel, concubine of Jacob
1092:
בִּלְהָן _n.pr.m_.
**1.** descendant of Esau
**2.** a Benjamite
1095: בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר _n.pr.m_. name given to Daniel by Neb.
1097:
בְּלִי _subst_. **wearing out**, hence
**1.** fig. **destruction**
**2.** **defect**, **failure**, hence _adv. of negation_
1099: בְלִימָה _n.[m.]_ **nothingness** [[18-job.26.7|Jb 26:7]] who hangeth the earth on בְּ׳.
